thread:
kai: New hire ran the JS starter and hit a weird schema failure during an fn-call. Error shows a literal string "__AUTH_REFRESH__" inside the JSON payload and the validator chokes.

anita: Can you paste the error and the raw payload?

kai: Error: SchemaValidationError: expected object but got string. Raw payload excerpt: '{"account":{"id":"acct_1"},"meta":"__AUTH_REFRESH__"}'

jord: Whoa. That looks like an auth refresh marker ended up in the stream. Any stack or logs?

kai: Minimal repro: run starter-js, trigger `create_account` fn-call while we run `dev/token-rotator` locally to force a mid-request refresh. Logs show the JS SDK client emitted a small `Authorization` refresh packet into the body when it retried the chunked stream: `<<-- AUTH_REFRESH: token_renewed -->>`

sam: Interesting — I think the JS streaming/retry middleware is doing an optimistic retry and accidentally appending the auth debug marker into the event stream payload instead of re-sending headers only. Python client refreshes before handshake so we didn't see this.

anita: Quick onboarding unblock?

kai: Workarounds we used during the session: 1) set env `RW_SDK_DISABLE_STREAM_RETRIES=true` in the starter to avoid the mid-stream retry, 2) run token rotator only after onboarding, or 3) change function schema to accept `meta` as string|object temporarily.

jord: We'll add a note to starter README recommending `RW_SDK_DISABLE_STREAM_RETRIES=true` for trainers until fix lands. Also add a tiny debug snippet to show how to check for the `__AUTH_REFRESH__` marker in logs so they don't waste time.

sam: I'll open a fix PR to ensure the JS retry path never writes debug/auth markers into the request body. Plan: move refresh to preflight for streaming requests and sanitize any injected debug tokens. Add unit tests simulating token rotate mid-stream.

ci-bot: CI task created: devex/js-sdk#512 -> staging, integration tests include flaky-token-rotate scenario.

anita: Can we also surface a clearer logger.warn when we detect a token marker in a JSON-mode response? Right now it's an opaque SchemaValidationError for new hires.

sam: Agreed. Will add a `logger.warn` with a link to the troubleshooting doc and the env workaround.

devex-bot: Noted: add starter README entry + onboarding checklist item.

kai: Thanks — that'll save the next batch of trainees. Will verify once CI completes. :thumbsup:
